# R44P33 external Stripe-mock truth boundary

Classification: `EXTERNAL_CI_STRIPE_MOCK_PROTOCOL_ONLY`.

This snapshot proves an externally executed, GitHub-hosted **protocol and schema exercise** against `stripe/stripe-mock:v0.202.0` plus local webhook-ledger semantics. It does **not** prove Stripe TEST mode, Stripe-hosted Checkout, actual Stripe webhook delivery, a real payment method, a real refund, customer delivery, sale readiness or LIVE readiness.

Current external denominator: 12/12 protocol cases; independent verifier 170/170; Sigstore/GitHub OIDC attestation present. Real Stripe TEST remains 0/12.
